claim: The exact original Unity 5.6.5p3 globalgamemanagers carries ClassID78 TagManager PathID3 as a full 932-byte source record at absolute 0x8CD8..0x907C, SHA256 d9a8f4f985a4e8c55bea8f51802214509e812bdce6dc59445b1e559d319a7e4f. Its original serialized tables comprise 18 tag strings, 32 named-or-blank layer slots, and four sorting-layer names with numeric unique IDs. Layer indices 10-21 explicitly contain StageWall, StageWall_Player, Ring, Ring_Player, BackRope, BackRope_Player, SideCorner, SideCorner_Player, FrontRope, FrontRope_Player, FrontIronPillar and FrontIronPillar_Player. Layer 27 contains FrontCage_Player, alongside audience, UI, preview and effect layers. Original sorting-layer names are Player, Default, Stage, Dialog with preserved unsigned numeric IDs. This is source-only project configuration, not geometry, object-layer membership or observed retail collisions.
